$comment: Failure scenarios for the Web Bot Auth profile, as data. A harness signs each request and directory scenario at run time with the reference library (http-message-sig signs any component and parameter set), applies after_signing, and grades the verifier on expected. created and expires are offsets in seconds from the harness clock; a null parameter is omitted; a nonce object asks for that many random bytes in that encoding. tier "wba": the reference library with no AdCP policy already gives the expected outcome. tier "adcp": the bare library gives the opposite outcome and only the profile rules give the expected one; a WBA MUST the library does not enforce stays "adcp" until it does. See README.md.

request_scenarios.name: Baseline
request_scenarios.basis: Profile rules

request_scenarios.name: Body changed after signing
request_scenarios.basis: Content-Digest matches the body: RFC 9530; WBA section 5.2

request_scenarios.name: Covered header changed after signing
request_scenarios.basis: RFC 9421 section 3.2

request_scenarios.name: Expired
request_scenarios.basis: RFC 9421 section 3.2.1

request_scenarios.name: created 120 seconds in the future
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: 60 seconds of clock skew

request_scenarios.name: created 30 seconds in the future
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: 60 seconds of clock skew; the library allows none by default

request_scenarios.name: Lifetime of 3600 seconds
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: expires at most 300 seconds after created

request_scenarios.name: Nonce of 32 bytes
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: 64-byte nonce; validateNonce

request_scenarios.name: Nonce in canonical padded base64
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: unpadded base64url or canonical padded base64

request_scenarios.name: Nonce in padded base64url
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: unpadded base64url or canonical padded base64

request_scenarios.name: No alg parameter
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: alg required

request_scenarios.name: alg other than ed25519
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: alg is ed25519 and matches the key; RFC 9421 section 3.2

request_scenarios.name: GET covering only @authority and the Signature-Agent member
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: cover @method, @target-uri, and @authority; WBA section 5.2 needs one of @authority or @target-uri

request_scenarios.name: Body without content-digest covered
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: a request with a body covers content-type and content-digest; WBA section 5.2

request_scenarios.name: tag other than web-bot-auth
request_scenarios.basis: WBA section 5.2: tag MUST be web-bot-auth

request_scenarios.name: Bare-string Signature-Agent
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: dictionary form only, so the field does not parse; WBA section 5.2.1 lets a verifier accept the bare string

request_scenarios.name: http:// Signature-Agent
request_scenarios.basis: WBA section 5.2.1: the origin MUST be https; the library accepts http (cloudflare/web-bot-auth#162)

request_scenarios.name: Signature-Agent with a path
request_scenarios.basis: WBA section 5.5: a directory member MUST be an origin; the library does not check it

request_scenarios.name: Signature-Agent origin with a trailing /
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: the value is exactly the serialized origin (RFC 6454 section 6.2), compared without normalizing

request_scenarios.name: Signature-Agent origin with an uppercase host
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: the value is exactly the serialized origin, with a lowercase host, compared without normalizing

request_scenarios.name: Signature-Agent origin with an explicit :443
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: the value is exactly the serialized origin, with no default port, compared without normalizing

request_scenarios.name: Signature-Agent member with type=jwks_uri
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: only type=directory; WBA section 5.2.1 lets a verifier ignore other types

request_scenarios.name: Signature-Agent member keyed differently from the label
request_scenarios.basis: WBA section 5.2.1: the member keyed to the label; the library does not check it

request_scenarios.name: Second signature with tag cdn-edge
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: Signature-Input members with other tags are not read; the library requires a label when a request carries two signatures

request_scenarios.name: Second member with tag cdn-edge whose Signature value is a token
request_scenarios.basis: RFC 9421 section 4.2: every Signature member value is a Byte Sequence, so the field is malformed whatever the member's tag; members with other tags are not read, but the field is still parsed

request_scenarios.name: Two Signature-Agent members, one signature
request_scenarios.basis: Profile: exactly one Signature-Agent member

request_scenarios.name: Label other than sig1
request_scenarios.label: wba
request_scenarios.basis: RFC 9421: the signer chooses the label

request_scenarios.name: Components in another order
request_scenarios.basis: RFC 9421: the order is the signer's

directory_scenarios.name: Body changed after signing
directory_scenarios.basis: WBA Appendix B.1: the verifier MUST validate Content-Digest; the library does not compare it with the body

directory_scenarios.name: Unsigned
directory_scenarios.basis: Profile: every Ed25519 key signs (Appendix B.1 recommends it)

directory_scenarios.name: Signature created in the future
directory_scenarios.basis: WBA Appendix B.1: reject a future created

directory_scenarios.name: Extra P-256 key that does not sign
directory_scenarios.basis: Profile: ignore keys the profile does not use (RFC 7517 section 5)

directory_scenarios.name: Media type application/json
directory_scenarios.basis: WBA section 5.5.1: the well-known directory MUST be served with application/http-message-signatures-directory+json
